violations.reason: tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts creates a self-contained in-test stub RuntimeThemeManager and hardcoded mock themeVariants (slate-600/slate-900) to test local helper functions rather than testing real production theme tokens, violating the client specification requiring Obsidian design tokens (#08090C, #11141C) and WCAG AAA (>= 7:1) verification.

PR #72 tests calibrate against WCAG AA 4.5:1 min ratio for arbitrary slate colors instead of enforcing the client specification and BARCAN-TAG-11 deontic gate requiring WCAG AAA minimum 7:1 contrast ratio against the Obsidian palette (#08090C, #11141C).
